decisions.proposed_text: Muốn hiểu tôi sao? Vậy hãy ra Turf.\nMọi thứ về tôi… Mejiro Ramonu, đều ở nơi đó.
decisions.reason: In this character introduction 草地 clearly refers to the racing surface where Mejiro Ramonu expresses herself; use canonical Turf rather than forbidden Sân cỏ.
Aston Machan identity, mascot dream and request to keep watching her are preserved naturally.
The embedded Power matcher fires on narrative 化逆境为力量, meaning turning adversity into strength rather than the gameplay Power stat; canonical context needs narrowing before local revision.
decisions.terminology_basis: Current common.stat.power match conflicts with narrative semantics.

canonical_finding.concept: Narrative strength gained from adversity must not automatically normalize to gameplay stat Power
canonical_finding.reason: This character-introduction phrase is metaphorical resolve, not a stat label or stat gain mechanic.

decisions.reason: Cheval Grand identity, self-doubt and aspiration to become great are preserved naturally.
Verxina identity and determination to become queen are preserved naturally.
Vivlos identity, Dubai aspiration and Cuộc đua concept are preserved naturally.
Dantsu Flame identity and conciliatory sweets-and-effort message are preserved naturally.

decisions.proposed_text: …Tôi là K.S. Miracle.\nĐể báo đáp tất cả những người đã trao cho tôi sự sống…\ntôi nhất định sẽ tạo nên kỳ tích.
decisions.reason: The locked character identity requires the punctuation form K.S. Miracle; the current K.S.Miracle misses the canonical spacing.
Jungle Pocket identity, challenge invitation and strongest-seat boast are preserved naturally.
Believe identity and reserved work-focused introduction are preserved naturally.
